scale_note: Real size. The wire is your caliper reading (5.53 mm); every other dimension is measured off your tape photo (1 inch = 245 px), so it is good to roughly ±1 mm. The pegboard is a generic 1/4" board, lined up on the pin.
notes: First pass: the wire path (top leg, S-jog, back leg, arm) and the pin are traced from your tape photo; the outline overlays the photo within about a millimetre. The printable STL lies on its side with 0.4 mm shaved off the bed side for a flat first layer. Please check: (1) does the shape match the real hook? (2) the S-jog: in this model it clips the edges of a 1/4" hole slightly, as the real hook's jog seems to in the photo. What is your board's thickness and hole size? (3) Do you want an exact plastic copy (5.5 mm plastic is much weaker than steel), or a beefier printable version, a longer arm, or a different shape?
